task: External Reuse Audit 20260917 — source-level capability index, built to shorten V2 implementation time
how_built: Both P0 repositories were already shallow-cloned under dataset/external/repositories/ (gitignored). Their working trees were materialised locally (Python repo: git checkout; Java repo: partial clone, blob:none, fetched on demand plus gh api for the files git could not read) and the source was read directly. Nothing here is taken from a README claim.

repos.language: Java 620 files / JavaFX desktop, module layout modules/{api,automation,desktop,tasks,vision}

A README sentence is not a license.
